Question:
What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT id, name, id AS root_id, 0 AS depth, 1.0::DOUBLE AS qty_mult
    FROM packaging
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pr.contains_id, p.name, p.root_id, p.depth + 1, (p.qty_mult::DOUBLE) * (pr.qty::DOUBLE)
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    JOIN packaging_tree p ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT id, name, root_id, depth, qty_mult
    FROM packaging_tree
    WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
all_leaf_totals AS (
    SELECT root_id, id AS leaf_id, qty_mult AS total_qty
    FROM leaf_items
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS num_leaf_items,
    SUM(total_qty) AS total_all_leaves,
    AVG(total_qty) AS avg_total_qty
FROM all_leaf_totals
